dag_infos.description: New Taipei criminal victim counts by source age band and victim gender. The 18-35 result is apportioned at query time because 30-39 crosses age 35.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市刑事案件被害者人數（按年齡、性別）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 API
data_infos.dataset_description: 來源是 19 筆年度寬表，主要欄位說明把 field1 與 item value2-item value27 對應到總計及年齡×性別欄位。保留全年齡、年齡明細及不詳年齡為不同 indicator_id；來源沒有行政區欄位，固定為新北市全市 area_code=65000。
data_infos.etl_description: Paginate the API with a browser User-Agent, resolve semantic aliases from the dataset field description, parse each age band into integer bounds, preserve unknown and total labels with null bounds, and reconcile every all-age male/female cell to the sum of age-band cells. Drop the confirmed 2006 and 2007 all-zero rows, then fail on any unknown three-times-median scale anomaly. The source is a count, not a rate; no 18-35 value is materialized.
